Buyer interest means “please check availability” — it is not a reservation or Formal Offer. Confirm the motorcycle, agreed seller purchase price and any seller hold first. Then create the Formal Offer with the exact customer price, services, deposit and an expiry that fits inside the seller commitment. If sold, mark it unavailable and keep the sourcing Deal open.
